offence_note: Possession for trafficking, production and trafficking of marihuana
sentence_quote: there will be a sentence of one year incarceration on Count 4, which is the charge of producing the controlled substance at Extension Road.
note: Concurrent one-year terms on all counts; conditional sentence refused.

offence_note: Five robberies and two counts of using imitation firearm
sentence_quote: the sentences on Counts 4, 6, 9, 12 and 18 each be reduced to 2 years and 71 days with credit granted for 294 days and that the sentence on Count 13 be consecutive to all other counts for a total sentence of 4 years and 71 days.
note: Global five years unchanged; enhanced pre-sentence custody credit granted.

offence_note: Robbery and unlawful confinement; long-term offender application
sentence_quote: confinement on September 16, 2009 of Dorothea Pronk, crediting him for four years on remand, and imposing a go-forward sentence of four years.
note: Eight years less four years remand credit; programming recommended in prison only.

offence_note: Assault with weapon, uttering threats, breaches of release order
sentence_quote: he reduced that sentence to 25 months' imprisonment. In the result, after applying 214 days of credit, he imposed an actual sentence of 536 days.
note: Conviction appeal also dismissed; leave to appeal sentence granted, appeal dismissed.

offence_note: Unlawful act manslaughter by careless handling of firearm
sentence_quote: For the offence of manslaughter, I sentence you to a term of imprisonment of 30 months.
systemic_quote: In a very real way, the presence of Gladue factors attenuates the moral blameworthiness of the offender.
note: Mandatory minimum conceded not to apply; sentence over two years so no conditional sentence.

offence_note: Possession of heroin and marihuana for purpose of trafficking
sentence_quote: I would grant Major leave to appeal sentence but dismiss the appeal.
note: Three years consecutive to sentence already being served; nine months concurrent on marihuana count. McBride sentence appeal abandoned.

offence_note: Dangerous operation of a motor vehicle
sentence_quote: I sentence you to a period of incarceration of four months.
note: Four months deemed fully served by five and a half months pre-trial custody.

offence_note: Obstruction of peace officer by lying about fatal hit and run
sentence_quote: Ms. Lu was given a suspended sentence, six months’ probation, and 75 hours of community service.
note: Conditional discharge sought on immigration grounds; refused; appeal dismissed.

offence_note: Conspiracy to traffic in cocaine and cannabis
sentence_quote: I would allow the Crown’s appeal of the sentence for conspiracy to traffic in cocaine and impose a 54-month sentence of imprisonment.
note: Increased from 36 to 54 months; balance stayed, no re-incarceration; two years concurrent on cannabis conspiracy.
